label: gl-vk-swapchain-rebuild-leak, before: every rebuild hands the old swapchain over as oldSwapchain
kind: real-window Vulkan probe, not a perf-suite capture (the suite never builds SdlVulkanHost)
machine: SPELDATOR, i7-14700K, RTX 4080 driver 610.62, Windows 11 26200, HDR display 4K at 150%, 120 Hz
configuration: Release, HULTUI_A11Y=0, SDL_WINDOW_ACTIVATE_WHEN_SHOWN=0, HULTUI_VULKAN_F16=1, HULTUI_VULKAN_PRESENT=mailbox, idle-gated, alternating with the after build

probes.mem: 40 resizes between 1637x1023 and 1600x1000 outer px (SetWindowPos NOACTIVATE on the UI thread, 120 ms apart); GPU Process Memory\Dedicated Usage (what Task Manager shows), Skia cache, nvidia-smi memory.used every 10
probes.sample: 60 resizes between 1200x840 and 900x700, 40 ms apart, while a second thread BitBlts one screen row through the window ~120 times a second and measures a bar drawn 300 px wide: 404 = stretched, 224 = squeezed
probes.vulkanProbe: tests/HultUI.UiTests.VulkanProbe --resizes=20: time for SetWindowPos to return, which includes the rebuild and the frames the window procedure draws
probes.oldHarness: the 2026-09-27 method: external SetWindowPos TOPMOST|NOACTIVATE, screen captured after it returns

mem650.note: the Task Manager figure passes the card's 16 GB while the GPU's memory in use stays flat: bookkeeping, not memory
